title: Friday said in words, same Monday ledger
script:
SPEAKING: Say Friday in words.
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-11 case. You name Friday, then accept the card's full 220 and the loan's full 640 on Monday 19 October 2026. No car promise.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- the card and the loan on Friday → say that is the day you want
- card 220 and loan 640 on Monday 19 October → accept, and confirm once
- any car-loan promise → refuse
- anything else → refuse
checks: one read-back names 220 and 640 on 19 October
